svg.title: Git history
svg.desc:
Glyphcss branching into charts and diagrams, with a hotfix and tagged releases.
* Fork polycss * ASCII rasteriser ├─┬─────╮ │ * │ Cell canvas │ ├─┬─╮ │ │ │ * │ │ Bars and lines │ │ * │ │ Braille trends (charts) │ │ │ * │ Graph layout (diagrams) │ ├─╯ │ │ │ * │ │ Charts (merge) │ │ │ * Font fallback (hotfix) ├─┼───┼─╯ * │ │ Fix fonts (merge, tag: v0.2.1) │ ├───╯ │ * Diagrams (develop, merge) ├─╯ * Charts + diagrams (main, merge, tag: v0.3.0)
